# Symbian C++ Documentation

> Complete reference for native Symbian C++ (Symbian OS 9.x / S60 3rd-5th Edition, Symbian^3): platform security, build system, language idioms (leaves, cleanup stack, two-phase construction, descriptors, active objects) and system APIs.

Start with AGENTS.md for rules and checklists.

## Core
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): hard rules, defaults, checklists, common mistakes
- [README.md](README.md): overview and table of contents
- [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md): terms and acronyms
- [REFERENCES.md](REFERENCES.md): books, papers, tools

- [examples/HelloConsole](examples/HelloConsole): minimal console EXE with cleanup stack, scheduler and an active-object timer
- [examples/HelloGui](examples/HelloGui): minimal S60 GUI application with registration, menu and icon
